description: This file handles the save operation for a Campaign entity in SuiteCRM. It retrieves a campaign record, checks access permissions, updates fields from POST data, manages campaign relationships (such as prospect lists for newsletters), duplicates campaign targets if needed, and performs a redirect after saving.

methods.name: populateFromPost
methods.description: Populates the Campaign bean's fields from POST data.

methods.name: handleRedirect
methods.description: Redirects to a specified page after save.
